title: Rabbitmq messaging topology operator: Go JOSE provides an implementation of the Javascript Object… (CVE-2026-116586)
description: CVE-2026-116586 affects the rabbitmq-messaging-topology-operator due to vulnerabilities in the Go JOSE library, which implements Javascript Object Signing and Encryption standards including JWE, JWS, and JWT. The issue impacts multiple versions prior to 1.16.0-r5, 2.9.1-r1, and 2.8.4-r1. A fix is available in these versions. The CVSS 4.0 base score is 6.9, indicating a medium severity vulnerability.
